$comment: The product's logo set for generate-logos.mjs. Paths are relative to the repository root (root, relative to this file). See README.md beside this file.

wave.why: Surgewave's signature is Blue Bright, the family light blue and the one exception to the shared lightness: the middle wind line, the upper arc (the crest) and the run wave, one role since the drawing paints wave and crest alike; 1.76:1 on white, a logo colour and never running text; 10.65:1 on #121212

ink.why: Navy, the family base: the body, the outer wind lines and the run Surge; 11.30:1 on white; white on dark (navy on #121212 would be 1.7:1)

background.why: Terracle's neutral light glass; behind apple-touch-icon.png and og-image
